propositions: Parser-owned CLI help text for 13 commands (verify-completion, sign-review, explain, review-plan, review-code, scan-spec, verify-identity, verify-authorship, verify-opcert, verify-commit-ticket, enrich, trusted-env, remote-cert) and overview.txt summaries violate documentation writing guidelines from docs/documentation-policy.md.
Violations include em/en dashes, semicolons, clause-joining colons, spaced-hyphen connectors, non-formal prose, and banned words in help strings committed by F12 (commit 131e75a).

Help text must be rewritten at maintained parser sources in llm.py, verify.py, enrich.py, certs.py, and remote_cert.py module docstring to comply with writing rules while preserving command semantics and technical identifiers.
Generated artifacts (src/rebar/_cli/help/*.txt and docs/cli-reference.md) must be regenerated from corrected parser sources using existing scripts and must pass drift checks with no manual edits.
